name: MGNREGS
full_name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme
description: Guarantees 100 days of wage employment per year to rural households whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
benefits: Unemployment allowance if work not provided
Job card issued free of cost
eligibility: Willing to do unskilled manual work
application_process: Apply at Gram Panchayat office with Job Card application form. Panchayat Sachiv will verify and issue Job Card within 15 days.
contact: Block Development Officer (BDO) or Panchayat Sachiv

name: PMAY-G
description: Provides financial assistance to rural BPL families for construction of pucca houses with basic amenities.
eligibility: Houseless or living in kutcha house
application_process: Beneficiary selection through SECC 2011 data. Apply through Panchayat or AwaasSoft portal.
contact: Panchayat Sachiv or Block Development Officer

name: JJM
description: Aims to provide safe and adequate drinking water through individual household tap connections to all rural households by 2024.
benefits: Piped water connection to every household
application_process: Apply through Gram Panchayat. Village Water & Sanitation Committee manages implementation.
contact: PHED (Public Health Engineering Department) or Panchayat Sachiv

name: SBM-G
description: Accelerates efforts to achieve universal sanitation coverage and improve cleanliness in rural India.
application_process: Apply at Gram Panchayat. Sachiv verifies and submits to Block. Incentive released after construction verification.
contact: Panchayat Sachiv or Block Sanitation Coordinator

name: 15th FC Grant
description: Untied and tied grants to Gram Panchayats for basic services including sanitation, drinking water, and maintenance of ODF status.
application_process: Automatic release based on devolution formula. Panchayat must submit utilization certificate.

name: NSAP
description: Provides financial assistance to elderly, widows, and disabled persons belonging to BPL households.
benefits: Lump sum on death of breadwinner
application_process: Apply at Gram Panchayat or Block office. Verification by Sachiv and BDO. Pension credited monthly.
contact: Panchayat Sachiv or Social Welfare Officer
